changes.approved_in: Owner instruction 2026-11-03 (Issue #43 work package B; pending Owner review)
changes.description: Issue #43 F02–F05 and R11 on the individual timeline: trail followed one edge at a time with remote nodes perceived only on arrival (F02); a search interrupted by short-range prey recruitment is closed at the interruption (F03); a late arrival joins a held prey without needing another unreserved prey (F04); every outside interval is charged exactly once, including the finder returning to recruit (F05); routes learned on arrival and recruitment done at the end of unloading with nestmates actually in the nest then (R11). false = v2-review.19 behaviour (isolation proof only).

changes.approved_in: Owner instruction 2026-11-03 (Issue #50 / #49 N1; merge authorised after CI and independent review)
changes.description: Issue #49 N1: brood care exposure for the day comes from the workers present at the start of the step; all brood is developed / killed before the day's eclosions are committed (new worker ids in source-pupa id order); a nurse's random larva contact maps to larvae in id order. An individual's fate no longer depends on its position in the brood array. false = v2-review.20 behaviour (isolation proof only).

changes.approved_in: Owner instruction 2026-11-03 (D4-A/D7-A next phase, work package C2; PR for Owner review, not merged by Claude)
changes.description: Work package C2: the engine records every movement of food between compartments as a food_transfer event (source, recipient, amount, minute, cause, attribution, contact) at the line that moves it, and checks per-compartment closure of every colony-day and world-wide source closure. No quantity, draw, decision or simulation state changes: removing the food_transfer events reproduces v2-review.21 byte for byte. The saved event lists (colony.last_events) and the daily journal grow by the recorded transfers.

changes.approved_in: Owner instruction 2026-11-03 (Codex Issue #61 R3-05; separate rules-update PR for Owner review, not merged by Claude)
changes.description: Codex Issue #61 R3-05: a worker carrying food it collected marks each edge of its walk home at the minute it has walked that edge (event-clock trail event; worker, edge, minute, minute it entered the edge, amount added, cause); no edge is written after the worker reached the nest. The decision (carrying food) and the amount per mark are unchanged. false = v2-review.22 behaviour (whole return route marked at the minute of arrival at the nest; isolation proof only).
